title: Tribesigns Wood End Table, 2-Drawer Narrow Side Table Slim Chair Solid Side Table, No Assembly Required, Finished Back

reviews.title: Great buy and stylish design
reviews.body: First, the end tables are beautiful and a superb quality-both the finish and sturdiness. There’s no assembly required so what could be better than that! The slimline size is perfect for the area on both ends of my couch and adds a stylish touch. The two drawers are narrow but deep and is more than enough room for my storage needs. I did change the knobs on the drawers to personalize to my taste, but that was simple to accomplish. I looked at end tables at several places and this was the best buy for wood furniture. I’ve had these tables in my “save for later” for months now and when I saw they were on sale, I pulled the trigger and ordered them. Now let’s talk about one of the most impressive features about these end tables-the way they were packaged for shipping! They were packaged individually in boxes that had specifically made doubled cardboard edges, styrofoam on the sides and fiberboard on the top and bottom of the box. They were well protected from possible damage to the boxes and arrived in perfect condition.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 25, 2026
reviews.author: Sandy Krell

reviews.title: Great Size and Quality!
reviews.body: I have looked for good quality smaller end tables for our livingroom for a long time. These end tables are perfect. They are beautiful, well made, solid wood end tables. They come very well packed in a sturdy box. Also, they were shipped in separate boxes. I did not rate them for assembly because they do not require assembly, they come fully assembled. They have 2 deep drawers that go back the entire length of the end table. I was able to fit a lot in the drawers, even a tray to put smaller items in such as pens, pencils, note pads, etc. The wood color is beautiful. I bought the set of 2 and I'm glad I did. My husband really likes them too. I have one next to his chair and one next to my chair. Everyone that comes to our house notices them and comments on how nice they are. I get a lot of questions regarding where I bought the them. I bought mine on a sale, but after seeing them and using them for about a month now, I think the regular price is still better than most others due to the quality of the end table. I don't know any furniture store that would sell  1 for the price I paid for 2 with the same quality as these end tables. I put them in my livingroom, but I think they would look good in a bedroom as well. I'm very pleased with this purchase. It was a good buy for our home.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 9, 2023

reviews.title: Excellent Craftsmanship
reviews.body: What a lovely end table! It arrived very carefully packed and required no assembly. It’s extremely well made, sturdy, and the design is both functional and beautiful. I highly recommend it!I gave it a four-star rating rather than a five for only one reason:  It’s not the warm walnut brown one expects from the picture, but rather an orange/red that doesn’t blend with any of our other furniture. However, it’s such a wonderful piece for the price, I’ll just wait until the weather permits then sand it lightly and apply a gel stain to cut some of that orange/red tone to hopefully make it appear more as pictured.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 28, 2024
reviews.author: P.R.

reviews.title: Exactely As Pictured
reviews.body: I ordered two of the Walnut finished units on July 8, 2025 and they arrived on July 11 via FedEx. Which was surprising to me since I have found FedEx tends to deliver later rather than sooner. Sometimes much later. I ordered them during the latest Amazon sale days event so they were $323.89 (plus tax) for the pair (today they are $409.99).In any event, they arrived very well packaged and damage free. They are just as pictured so what you see is what you get. I live full time in a motorhome so space is at a premium for me. These end tables can fit just about anywhere. I have placed them on either end of a loveseat and they look great.The drawers slide easily even though they are on wooden slides and have stops at the end of their travel so you can't accidentally pull them all the way out. But because they are on wooden slides they don't open al the way like they could using metal slides.The sides of the drawers are lower than the curved front but the opening is clear all the way to the top of the curved front part. This allows taller items to be placed in them. thus they are not limited to the height of the sides. The insides of the drawers are semi-finished. By semi-finished I mean they are painted/stained but not smooth to the touch. Nonetheless they look finished. The bottom is smooth.TAKE CARE though as some of the edges on the inside areas of the drawers are rough and you can pickup splinters from the edges when rubbing your fingers along them.The curved raised part on the top does not mate perfectly with the straight sections on each side so the point where they join is visible (and you can feel it). Given the price, however, this is not a deal breaker for me. The back is also semi-finished but looks fine and putting the unit away from the wall such that it could be seen should not be a problem.Overall the finish is uniform and I would say it has more of a matt-finish  than glossy. I am quite pleased with these end tables.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 13, 2025
reviews.author: WS

reviews.title: What a beautiful piece of furnitue!
reviews.body: We recently downsized and didn't have enough room in our living room for my husband's old end table.  I went searching for something that was narrow, but also useful... and I found it in this one!!It came fully assembled and VERY WELL packaged.  It's very nicely made and feels like nice quality materials.  The drawers offer way more storage space than I expected, and they both pull out very smoothly.  The top has plenty of space for his drink and a snack bowl.  It's a beautiful piece of furniture.There are cheaper options out there, but this one is by far the best one I found.  It is well worth the price because it won't fall apart after just a few months of use.  It doesn't feel like it's going to become rickety or wobbly at all.  Overall, we are VERY happy with this table.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 3, 2023
